value.rationale: A complete Euclidean vertex-inertia classification of a natural infinite family of fixed-size graph matching polytopes, connecting rook-placement correlations to a sharp condition number decreasing from 5 to 1. Unlike full crown derangements (many deterministic affine constraints) or all-cardinality partial permutations (strong growing anisotropy), the 3-matching cloud is exactly codimension one and approaches isotropy with explicit 2/n rate. Full spectrum, all multiplicities, and boundary phase are structurally motivated, not arbitrary small-order computations.
